newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone declines comment on AT&T bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone declines comment on AT&T bid talk.

text.p: British mobile telephone company Vodafone Group Plc on Wednesday would not comment on revived market talk that U.S. telecoms giant AT & T Corp was planning to bid for the UK company.
"We are in our closed period (ahead of half-year results)," noted a company spokesman, before adding: "We never comment on market rumours."
Market sources, however, said they thought such a bid unlikely.

Vodafone's shares jumped 11.5 pence to 245 pence by 1030 GMT. Some analysts attributed the rise partly to a pick-up in the mobile telephone market. Heavy buying of Vodafone call options also helped to boost the stock, dealers said.
Vodafone releases half year results on November 19.
